evidence.quote: It was trained using the same data sources as phi-1, augmented with a new data source that consists of various NLP synthetic texts.

Our training data for phi-1.5 is a combination of phi-1’s training data (7B tokens) and newly created synthetic, “textbook-like” data (roughly 20B tokens) for the purpose of teaching common sense reasoning and general knowledge of the world (science, daily activities, theory of mind, etc.).

A filtered code-language dataset, which is a subset of The Stack and StackOverflow, obtained by using a language model-based classifier (consisting of about 6B tokens). A synthetic textbook dataset consisting of <1B tokens of GPT-3.5 generated Python textbooks. A small synthetic exercises dataset consisting of ∼180M tokens of Python exercises and solutions.
